projectBackups.title: Project backups
projectBackups.exportDescription: Save the project's conversations, managed images, and documents with their references. Workspace files and channel credentials are excluded.
projectBackups.restoreDescription: Choose a Tinker project backup to review its contents before restoring.
projectBackups.rebind: You can link a local folder to the restored project separately.
projectBackups.duplicate: This project backup was already restored.

errors.backupFileExists: A file already exists at this location. Choose a new file name.
errors.backupFileUnavailable: Could not read or save the backup file. Choose another file or location.
errors.backupTooLarge: The backup exceeds the allowed size.
errors.backupSelectionExpired: The backup selection expired. Choose the backup again.
errors.invalidProjectArchive: This file is not a valid Tinker project backup.
errors.archiveChecksumMismatch: The backup failed its integrity check.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This version of Tinker cannot open the backup format.
errors.storageLimit: The backup exceeds the allowed content or storage limits.
errors.projectConflict: The backup conflicts with an existing project. Existing project data was kept.
errors.recoveryRequired: Restart the preview to recover the previous backup operation.
errors.projectArchiveBusy: Finish or stop the active project tasks, then try again.
errors.missingArchiveAsset: The project backup is missing a required asset.
errors.imageDialogBusy: Close the other file dialog and try again.
errors.failed: The project backup operation could not be completed.
errors.refresh: The backup is restored, but the project list could not refresh.
